title: One-sided Gaussian-tail domination forces every mixture variance below the reference

statement.quantifiers: Every probability mixture of real Gaussians, with arbitrary means and nonnegative component variances, and sigma²>=0; upper-tail domination by centered N(0,sigma²) for every real R.
statement.assertion: Component variances <=sigma² almost surely. For three target laws G_a-b_a X with b_a>=0,X>=0 and Gaussian covariance Sigma, common separable mixing from LA017 forces c_a<=Sigma_aa. Thus trSigma<1/2 contradicts sum c_a>=1/2; no vanishing TV-distance subsequence to SEP exists. For fixed unital T, Sigma=(I-TT^T)/4 gives trSigma=(3-||T||F²)/4.
assumptions: Same mixing law for all three marginals.
Nonnegative one-sided displacement after sign choice.

inputs: Upper-tail domination for every R and a common covariance-constrained mixing law.
outputs: Almost-sure componentwise variance bound; candidate positive asymptotic TV separation.
interface.precision: Existential positive liminf; no explicit gap or certified finite-N score.
costs: Bounded smooth separating scores exist, but score acquisition, useful sample complexity and finite-N onset remain open.

proof_mechanism: If excessive variance has positive mass, restrict to variance>=sigma²+eps and bounded means.
Its slower Gaussian upper tail eventually exceeds reference, contradiction; zero reference variance excludes every positive component.
Apply each marginal to the SAME law; sum variance bounds contradict separable trace constraint.
A zero-TV subsequence gives matching weak marginals/common law, impossible; data processing transfers to halftrace.
obstructions: Two-sided target displacement need not be upper-tail dominated.
No uniform gap for T_N approaching ||T||F²=1.
No unfiltered trace-distance inference from exponentially rare filtered witness.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Prove common mixture/tightness, one-sided target tail and admitted channel/parameter limits; handle finite costs separately.

review.source_reported: Source derivation and finite diagnostics; no independent agent/external/formal review. Intake did not replay suites.
